_how: Real responses from the server's own call_tool() at repo d77186f, run offline in a scratch venv with osascript/open/screencapture shimmed to fail (no GUI touched; Tableau Public is not installed on this machine). Paths scrubbed to <data>/<output>. Spec = the README's map worksheet wrapped in a minimal workbook spec over tests/fixtures/data/ev_site_readiness.csv.
